metadata.name: NVIDIA Run:ai
metadata.description: MCP server for NVIDIA Run:ai that lets AI agents inspect workloads, query GPU resource utilization and quotas, and diagnose scheduling issues on a Run:ai cluster. Write tools (submitting workloads, managing node pools and org units) are disabled by default.

config.notes: Local mode: runs the server in Docker on your own machine against an existing NVIDIA Run:ai cluster (2.25 or later). RUNAI_BASE_URL is the cluster's Run:ai URL; RUNAI_CLIENT_ID and RUNAI_CLIENT_SECRET are Run:ai application credentials used for OAuth2 client-credentials login. Set RUNAI_ALLOW_WRITE_TOOLS=true to enable write tools. A cluster administrator can instead deploy one shared HTTP server, reached at https://<fqdn>/mcp.
